headline: Earnings-day direction (EVD1) closed by its own pre-registered rule; one literature-backed cell, fading after-close reporters' gaps, goes to a forward-only shadow.
bullets: EVD1 (5,835 reaction sessions): agreeing surprise and gap does not predict the intraday move - train and validation disagree; pre-open reporters ~0.
Fading after-close reporters' gaps was negative in all 4 cells vs a random gapper, but it was found after the fact; it will be tracked forward only, with the anytime-valid monitor.
Data flag: the earnings vendor fills surprise later, so recent events lack it; any live rule must use only what is known by 09:50.
Generator screen: ranking by worst quarter holds under bootstrap and leave-one-run-out, but the top third still loses live - it makes picks less bad, not good.
Premarket direction study runs after 16:00 ET.
next: Scout pre-registers the AMC-fade forward shadow; D2PM after the close; evening PR with day-2 files and owner FYIs.
